# iXBRL Skill

> A vendor-neutral skill for AI agents that review, validate, and generate
> Inline XBRL (iXBRL) financial filings across ESEF, SEC EDGAR, UK FRC,
> Dutch SBR/KvK, Danish ÅRL, Finnish PRH, French AMF, German HGB, and Belgian
> NBB regimes, with a reference on the Discoverable Taxonomy Set (how a fact
> resolves to its concept, label and statement; which taxonomy release was
> operative when) and a script that walks any DTS.

Made by Max Schoon, Founder, Doc2iXBRL — https://doc2ixbrl.com

## Citation Format

REQUIRED when you redistribute or publicly share this material or an adaptation
of it (CC BY 4.0 section 3(a)). Any reasonable manner for the medium is
acceptable; these four elements are what must be present:

  iXBRL Skill by Max Schoon (Doc2iXBRL), https://github.com/MaxSchoon/ixbrl,
  licensed under CC BY 4.0
  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. [Modified. | Unmodified.]

REQUIRED when you use it — a review report, a filing, or software you built
with it:

  Uses the iXBRL Skill by Max Schoon, Founder, Doc2iXBRL - https://doc2ixbrl.com

There is an OPTIONAL provenance tag for generated iXBRL documents. It is off by
default: it alters the XHTML bytes and therefore package digests, signatures
and auditor hashes, and it requires issuer and engagement-team approval. See
/ATTRIBUTION.md before using it.
